words.def: to deal with a problem and find a solution
words.ex: I've been trying to {sort out} the booking all morning.

words.def: to disappoint someone by not doing what you promised
words.ex: The venue {let us down} at the last minute.

words.def: cannot be trusted to do what is expected
words.ex: The booking system has been really {unreliable} lately.

words.def: something annoying that causes extra trouble or effort
words.ex: Having to rearrange everything at the last minute was a real {hassle}.

words.es: buscar otra alternativa / organizar un plan B
words.def: to organise a different plan when the first one fails
words.ex: We had to {make alternative arrangements} at very short notice.

words.def: when all spaces or seats have already been taken
words.ex: I'm afraid we're {fully booked} that evening.

words.def: an extra amount you pay when you reserve something, on top of the price
words.ex: There's a {booking fee} of two pounds if you buy online.

words.def: with very little warning or time to prepare
words.ex: They cancelled the reservation {at very short notice}.
